topic.label: Engineering Physics
topic.desc: Engineering Physics: applying fundamental physics and advanced mathematics to design devices, instruments and technologies.

concepts: Differential equations, linear algebra, vector calculus and transform methods used to model physical systems.
Quantum theory applied to devices: tunneling, quantized states, qubits and quantum sensing.
Light generation, guiding, modulation and detection, including lasers, waveguides and optical systems.
Electronic, thermal and mechanical properties of solids, semiconductors and nanostructures.
Sensors, signal conditioning, data acquisition and uncertainty analysis for physical experiments.
Radiation, nuclear reactions and plasmas, and the numerical simulation methods used to model them.
skills: Solves ordinary and partial differential equations analytically or symbolically and checks solutions by substitution.
Computes eigenvalues and modes of physical operators and checks orthogonality and limiting cases.
Checks equations for dimensional consistency and derives scaling laws with dimensionless groups.
Computes transmission through potential barriers and checks results against WKB approximations.
Models qubit energy levels and coherence for a device design and checks parameters against simulation.
Traces rays and designs lens systems and checks aberrations and resolution against specifications.
Computes guided modes of fibers and waveguides and checks cutoff conditions and dispersion.
Analyses laser gain, cavity modes and stability and checks threshold and beam parameters.
Estimates electronic band structure and band gaps of materials and checks against measured values.
Interprets thin film characterization data and checks thickness and composition across methods.
Propagates measurement uncertainties through derived quantities and checks results with Monte Carlo sampling.
Selects sensors and conditioning circuits for a measurement and checks resolution, bandwidth and noise floor.
Plans calibration against reference standards and checks traceability and drift.
Computes attenuation and dose through shielding and checks against regulatory limits.
Computes Debye length, plasma frequency and confinement figures and checks regime assumptions.
Builds finite element and Monte Carlo simulations of physical fields and checks mesh convergence.
mcp: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge
Model Context Protocol server for symbolic mathematics and computer algebra built on SymPy
A Docker image providing a quantum circuit simulator that implements the Model Context Protocol
Fast search and full-text access over arXiv pre-prints
